PARSECOVE

Privacy

A little transparency goes a long way.

Your inputs stay in this browser.

ParseCove’s conversion code processes your text and files on your device. It does not upload tool inputs, use external conversion APIs, save input history, or include advertising, analytics or session-replay scripts.

What the hosting platform handles

Loading this website sends normal web requests to its hosting provider. The provider may process request metadata, logs and authentication cookies under its own policies. Local processing does not mean visiting the website creates no network requests.

Files and clipboard

Files are read only when you select or drop them. The clipboard is written only when you press a Copy button. Downloads are created locally. Reloading clears the application’s in-memory inputs; browser form restoration may behave differently.

Sharing

Tool inputs are not added to the address bar. Downloaded files and anything you copy may still contain personal data; share them thoughtfully.

Built for the little things that slow you down.
